implementation.behavior: Enumerates shared physical EDRAM tile IDs and source/destination tile coordinates for a pair of captured layouts. It supports differing sample counts through the existing sample-address and reverse-coordinate helpers. Ordered-renderer fail-closed diagnostics report same-plane alias counts or the map's ambiguity reason.
implementation.safety: Rejects a full layout extent that wraps one physical tile more than once. Such an image-to-backing mapping needs exact draw coverage and operation order. It does not infer color/depth format conversion or transfer Vulkan image data.
implementation.format_scope: The existing 32bpp EDRAM address model; true 64bpp color addressing remains unsupported.

retail_layout_regression.tile_coordinate_mapping: Identity for all shared tile IDs: 16 columns x 45 rows.
retail_layout_regression.sample_address_regression: For physical tile 0, all 1,280 tile-local sample slots map through both layouts to the same byte address, independently for color and depth.
retail_layout_regression.classification: Captured target metadata drives the address regression; no retail image payload or Vulkan rendering is used.

first_transition_limit.result: Unique full-extent tile mapping fails closed because it spans more than the 2,048-tile EDRAM store.
first_transition_limit.interpretation_limit: The captured metadata does not establish which tiles the draw geometry/scissor touches. This is a limit of the current full-extent mapping model, not proof that the retail draw itself is invalid.

android_arm64.device_runtime: not run; adb devices -l returned no connected devices

remaining_blockers: No shared Vulkan physical EDRAM backing or sample data transfer is implemented.
The 2560x1440 draw-0 full extent wraps under the current 32bpp mapping; actual touched tiles need captured geometry/scissor evidence before backing transfer can be defined.
The supported 720-tile mapping does not implement raw-format reinterpretation, copy/convert, clear, or depth/stencil persistence.
This regression is not execution of the full 14-draw retail transition and makes no retail parity claim.
